known_limits: Original portrait content is 203–348px wide. Larger provided files are interpolated, not freshly generated high-resolution detail.
Native backgrounds are 313–522px wide, not final full-screen HD artwork.
Faces have a family of semi-realistic styles; age, facial hair, decorative emblems and costumes do not fully match the previous strict 1570 art brief.
Hair/shoulder edges may need further cleanup on the actual game background.
Landscape paintings may contain fixed people, props, maps, flags or decorative crests; do not treat them as gameplay-state-driven elements.
Terrain images are color maps only; not measured PBR materials. Actual tiling scale remains untested.
This is 2D imagery, not 3D character meshes or explorable environments.
